Speaky's Dog Show
история Speak & Smile · читаем хором
тапни / стрелка →
Speaky is at the circus today.
He's got a friend — Coco!
Let's watch the show!
Speaky says: “Coco, STAND UP!”
Coco stands up. Look at that pup!
🐶 “Woof! I can stand up!”
Speaky says: “Coco, SIT DOWN!”
Coco sits down — best dog in town!
🐶 “Woof! I can sit down!”
Speaky says: “HANDS UP!”
Up, up, up! Coco's paws go up!
🐶 “Woof! Look — paws up!”
Speaky says: “CLAP!”
Clap, clap, clap! Everybody clap!
🐶 “Woof-woof! Clap, clap!”
Speaky says: “Take a BOW!”
…but Coco jumps up — SLURP! A kiss! POW!
Speaky's cap goes flying — ha, ha, ha!
🦝 “Ha ha! Good dog, Coco!”
Now YOU try!
Stand up! Sit down!
Hands up! Clap!
And… take a BOW!
🎉 Hooray!
